metadata.question: Was the percentage of cloud cover over Lago Hermoso, Argentina higher on March 29, 1987 (morning) compared to February 15, 2001?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy (Collection, Date, Location).
- Location: Lago Hermoso, Argentina. Use a point at (-71.44, -40.39) buffered 5 km.
- Dates:
  • 1987-03-29 (filter to morning via UTC hour 11–15, which is local UTC−3 morning 8–12).
  • 2001-02-15 (no special hour filter).
- Collections:
  • For 1987: LANDSAT/LT05/C02/T1_L2 then fallback LANDSAT/LT04/C02/T1_L2.
  • For 2001: LANDSAT/LE07/C02/T1_L2 then fallback LANDSAT/LT05/C02/T1_L2.
- If exact-day search fails, widen to ±3 days, then ±30 days.

2. Masking strategy (Should I mask clouds? Or is the question about clouds?).
- Do not mask clouds; instead compute cloud percentage using QA_PIXEL:
  cloudy = (DilatedCloud OR Cirrus OR Cloud) AND not Fill.
  valid = not Fill.
- Cloud% = cloudy_count / valid_count * 100.

3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3).
- If collections empty after fallbacks: C1.
- If valid_count == 0 for either date: C2.
- If resulting percentages are null/NaN or invalid: C3.
- Otherwise compare: 1987_morning_cloud% > 2001_cloud% ? A : B.
</thinking>

<code>
```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const lagoHermoso = ee.Geometry.Point([-71.44, -40.39]).buffer(5000); // 5 km buffer
    const tzOffsetHours = -3; // Argentina local time ~ UTC-3

    const target1987 = ee.Date('1987-03-29');
    const target2001 = ee.Date('2001-02-15');

    // Helper to format date strings for printing
    function dateInfo(img) {
      const utc = ee.Date(img.get('system:time_start'));
      const local = utc.advance(tzOffsetHours, 'hour');
      return ee.Dictionary({
        utc: utc.format('YYYY-MM-dd HH:mm'),
        local: local.format('YYYY-MM-dd HH:mm')
      });
    }

    // 2. Data Acquisition & Check with fallbacks
    async function findNearestImage(geom, targetDate, exactDaysWindow, widenDaysList, collections, morningFilterUTC) {
      // morningFilterUTC: optional ee.Filter for hours (UTC)
      async function searchWithWindow(days, applyMorningFilter) {
        const start = targetDate.advance(-days, 'day');
        const end = targetDate.advance(days + 1, 'day'); // inclusive end window
        let colAll = ee.ImageCollection(collections[0])
          .filterBounds(geom)
          .filterDate(start, end);
        if (applyMorningFilter) {
          colAll = colAll.filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(11, 15, 'hour')); // UTC 11-15 ~ local 8-12
        }
        // Try primary then fallbacks
        let col = colAll.map(img => img.set('diffDays', img.date().difference(targetDate, 'day').abs()));
        let size = await col.size().getInfo();
        let usedCollection = collections[0];
        if (size === 0 && collections.length > 1) {
          for (let i = 1; i < collections.length; i++) {
            let tmp = ee.ImageCollection(collections[i])
              .filterBounds(geom)
              .filterDate(start, end);
            if (applyMorningFilter) tmp = tmp.filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(11, 15, 'hour'));
            tmp = tmp.map(img => img.set('diffDays', img.date().difference(targetDate, 'day').abs()));
            const s = await tmp.size().getInfo();
            if (s > 0) {
              col = tmp;
              size = s;
              usedCollection = collections[i];
              break;
            }
          }
        }
        if (size === 0) {
          return { size: 0, usedCollection: null, img: null, windowDays: days, appliedMorning: applyMorningFilter };
        }
        const img = ee.Image(col.sort('diffDays').first());
        const d = dateInfo(img);
        const utcStr = await d.get('utc').getInfo();
        const localStr = await d.get('local').getInfo();
        return { size, usedCollection, img, windowDays: days, utcStr, localStr, appliedMorning: applyMorningFilter };
      }

      // Try exact day with/without morning as requested
      const tries = [];
      // Exact window first
      tries.push(await searchWithWindow(exactDaysWindow, morningFilterUTC));
      // Widen windows
      for (const w of widenDaysList) {
        tries.push(await searchWithWindow(w, morningFilterUTC));
      }
      // If still none and we required morning, try same windows without morning filter
      if (morningFilterUTC) {
        tries.push(await searchWithWindow(exactDaysWindow, false));
        for (const w of widenDaysList) {
          tries.push(await searchWithWindow(w, false));
        }
      }
      // Pick the first with size > 0
      for (const t of tries) {
        if (t.size && t.size > 0) return t;
      }
      return { size: 0, usedCollection: null, img: null };
    }

    // 3. Processing: Cloud percentage using QA_PIXEL (Landsat C2 L2)
    async function cloudStats(img, geom) {
      const qa = img.select('QA_PIXEL');
      const notFill = qa.bitwiseAnd(1).eq(0); // bit 0 == 0
      const dilated = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 1).neq(0);
      const cirrus = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 2).neq(0);
      const cloud = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 3).neq(0);
      const cloudy = dilated.or(cirrus).or(cloud).and(notFill);

      const validCount = ee.Image.constant(1).updateMask(notFill).reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry: geom,
        scale: 1000,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      }).get('constant');

      const cloudCount = ee.Image.constant(1).updateMask(cloudy).reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry: geom,
        scale: 1000,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      }).get('constant');

      const v = await validCount.getInfo();
      const c = await cloudCount.getInfo();

      if (v === null || c === null) return { ok: false, reason: 'null' };
      if (v === 0) return { ok: false, reason: 'novalid' };

      const pct = (c / v) * 100.0;
      if (!isFinite(pct)) return { ok: false, reason: 'nan' };
      return { ok: true, valid: v, cloudy: c, pct: pct };
    }

    // Perform searches
    const res1987 = await findNearestImage(
      lagoHermoso,
      target1987,
      0,
      [3, 30],
      ['LANDSAT/LT05/C02/T1_L2', 'LANDSAT/LT04/C02/T1_L2'],
      true // morning filter for 1987
    );

    const res2001 = await findNearestImage(
      lagoHermoso,
      target2001,
      0,
      [3, 30],
      ['LANDSAT/LE07/C02/T1_L2', 'LANDSAT/LT05/C02/T1_L2'],
      false
    );

    // Handle C1 if needed
    if (!res1987.img || !res2001.img) {
      if (!res1987.img) console.log('1987: No images found after fallbacks.');
      if (!res2001.img) console.log('2001: No images found after fallbacks.');
      console.log('C1');
      return;
    }

    // Calculate cloud stats
    const stats1987 = await cloudStats(res1987.img, lagoHermoso);
    const stats2001 = await cloudStats(res2001.img, lagoHermoso);

    // Handle C2 or C3
    if (!stats1987.ok || !stats2001.ok) {
      if (!stats1987.ok) {
        if (stats1987.reason === 'novalid') console.log('1987: No valid pixels after QA (C2).');
        else console.log('1987: Calculation failure (C3).');
      }
      if (!stats2001.ok) {
        if (stats2001.reason === 'novalid') console.log('2001: No valid pixels after QA (C2).');
        else console.log('2001: Calculation failure (C3).');
      }
      const code = (!stats1987.ok && stats1987.reason === 'novalid') || (!stats2001.ok && stats2001.reason === 'novalid') ? 'C2' : 'C3';
      console.log(code);
      return;
    }

    // 4. Print concise evidence
    const ctr1987 = `${res1987.usedCollection}`;
    const ctr2001 = `${res2001.usedCollection}`;
    console.log(`Area: Lago Hermoso (-40.39,-71.44), buffer=5km`);
    console.log(`1987-03-29 images: ${res1987.size} [${ctr1987}], morning=${res1987.appliedMorning ? 'yes' : 'no'}`);
    console.log(`Chosen 1987: UTC ${res1987.utcStr}, Local-3 ${res1987.localStr} | Valid: ${stats1987.valid}, Cloudy: ${stats1987.cloudy}, Cloud%: ${stats1987.pct.toFixed(2)}`);
    console.log(`2001-02-15 images: ${res2001.size} [${ctr2001}]`);
    console.log(`Chosen 2001: UTC ${res2001.utcStr}, Local-3 ${res2001.localStr} | Valid: ${stats2001.valid}, Cloudy: ${stats2001.cloudy}, Cloud%: ${stats2001.pct.toFixed(2)}`);
    const higher = stats1987.pct > stats2001.pct;
    console.log(`Comparison: 1987 > 2001 ? ${higher}`);

    // 5. Final Answer
    console.log(higher ? 'A' : 'B');
  } catch (err) {
    console.log(`Error: ${err}`);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
